findings: Scope: this is the authoring pass, so I judged the scene scripts and the production notes against the four polish advisories and the frozen inputs. I did not view the finished film. The film is judged in the second pass through the new contact sheet and sampled stills. The film in the tree is still the previous round's film.

Design system: design/DESIGN.md and design/tokens.json exist, so the no-design-system rule does not apply. Every token (palette, typography, spacing, layout, motion) is still TODO. The film is a Blender render with no CSS or HTML, so it uses no undefined tokens and I raise no token findings. The only documented rules are the four quality bars, which I applied by analogy: visual hierarchy, 3:1 contrast for large text, grouping and whitespace.

Advisory 1, section 4 title band: production-notes.md records the 'Stations build' title moved from z 4.1 to z 5.28. The notes say the highest line geometry (arm tips and caps, about z 4.38) projects about 40 px below the glyph bottoms, and the title still travels with the camera. This addresses the quality bars on visual hierarchy and whitespace as clear content boundaries. I did not check the scene_line.py code against these figures. They are the producer's arithmetic, not a viewed frame. Proof is for the second pass: frame-mid-4 and the section 4 sampled stills must show no line geometry crossing the glyphs.

Advisory 2, section 6 captions: the notes record both captions parented to the camera and staggered. 'A human approves.' sits right and high, and 'Verified memory.' sits left and lower, so they no longer form one column. 'Verified memory.' keys in at 0.40 to 0.47 of the section, so it is on screen at the midpoint and in the final frame. Projected archive, pane and gate tops are below the caption band. Proof is for the second pass: frame-mid-6 and frame-cut-6-last must show both captions fully legible, with no overlap of each other or of the geometry.

Advisory 3, section 1 opening title: the notes record the ANVIL title on the full ink material from frame 1, at 0.97 scale at frame 1 and full scale by 0.15 of the section. The dolly and the line assembly keys are untouched. This addresses the scale contrast and hierarchy bars. Proof is for the second pass: the new frame-proof-s1-title.png at about 30 percent (frame 91 of 302) must show the title in full ink at near full scale, matching the section end.

Advisory 4, section 2 flight and dead air: the notes record the card entering in frame, its X tilt running 78, 68, 42, 14, 0 degrees, and the camera riding about 5.5 to 6 units off the card. The projected midpoint card width is about 540 px, where the previous film showed it tiny and edge on. The other sections were audited from geometry. The first frame of section 3, where the small card sits in front of dark posts, is flagged as a risk to check. Proof is for the second pass: frame-mid-2, frame-cut-2-last and frame-cut-3-first.

Contact sheet sampling: assemble.py keeps every existing still name. It adds frame-cut-2-last, frame-cut-3-first, frame-cut-4-last and frame-cut-5-first, so every cut after sections 1 to 6 is sampled as a pair. It adds frame-proof-s1-title.png at 30 percent of section 1. This covers what the second-pass design review needs.

Frozen inputs and render budget: git status shows no modification to script.md, storyboard.md, brief.md, source-pack.md, durations.json or audio/. The notes record the Eevee TAA samples at 6 (never above 8), shadows and raytracing off, 30 fps and no frames cut. The earlier commit e9d346f is documented as an empty commit. In the notes, the render statistics block is described as left for tools/render_stats.py. The notes say the film review section stays to be completed in the second pass.
